title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Senior Citizens
Senior citizens
60 years of age by start date of lectures, including Canadian and Visa students, are exempt from
tuition
for all Wilfrid Laurier University courses* but
are responsible for payment of all virtual learning charges,
incidental
and/or miscellaneous fees, and associated digital textbooks
, where applicable.
Senior students
65 years of age or older
registered in
Martin Luther University College
courses are eligible for 30% tuition fee exemption*. Students are responsible for 70% tuition fees, and
all virtual learning charges,
incidental
and/or miscellaneous fees, and associated digital textbooks
, where applicable.
*All
non-publicly funded program fees
are not eligible for the senior citizen tuition fee exemption waiver.
